principles.display: Closed changed-only kind/field vocabulary with known_value, known_none, and unknown. No raw variables or current-profile reconstruction.
principles.general: A new sale with customer_id null and no customer_name is known_none General. A null id with a nonblank written name is a name-only known_value identity. Missing legacy evidence is unknown.
principles.retention: sale_record_events and return_mutation_receipts are immutable, included in backup/reset lifecycle, and excluded from ordinary audit/action-history pruning.
principles.legacy: Genuine historical sale-related rows without exact typed evidence remain one legacy_sale_change record with actor/time and details unavailable. They are not silently dropped.

not_yet_captured.action: customer return creation changes parent sale status
not_yet_captured.reason: The first event implementation was reverted after a proven concurrent same-sale creation race. The safe replacement requires one atomic header/items/allocations/stock/status/event batch with stable item ids; no provisional row is allowed.
not_yet_captured.preserved_behavior: Existing return and audit history remains visible as legacy_sale_change rather than disappearing.

not_yet_captured.reason: This older direct route has no stable request receipt/event. The released F72 interaction uses the captured bulk-update kernel, but scripted or stale callers can still reach this route.

not_yet_captured.action: customer profile carry rename/phone/address and merge/relink/resolve-missing
not_yet_captured.reason: contacts.ts can rewrite sales customer snapshots or ids without per-sale immutable F74 events. Record-only profile edits intentionally do not mutate a sale and need no Sales Record.
not_yet_captured.privacy: Any future event must retain only customer id/name and membership identity needed for the change; it must not bulk-copy current phone/address into the immutable event ledger.

not_yet_captured.reason: settings.ts rewrites historical sale payment labels in one guarded operation but does not yet append per-sale immutable F74 events.

not_yet_captured.action: legacy positive-id customer whose profile is semantically General
not_yet_captured.reason: Current creation classification treats every positive customer id as a real profile. Root is coordinating a shared canonical-anonymous predicate; F74 does not fabricate a null identity or rewrite old history before that decision.

release_dependencies: Direct status and return edit server requirements must ship with a frontend that freezes client_request_id and expected_updated_at before send and preserves exact requests across unknown outcomes.
The current frontend candidate e04e0b15 has a separate blocked review for pending-request retention bounds and Undo/Redo reconciliation; backend commits alone are not a release candidate.
No migration, deployment, remote D1 command, or production write was performed.
